tracks.objective: Determine whether fibre-scale selective treatments can deliver durable dyed-wool washability without unacceptable strength, colour, comfort, residue, exposure or effluent trade-offs.
tracks.maximum_inference: Only the tested fibre/dye/construction/treatment lot and wash/dry envelope; no universal washable-wool or dry-clean replacement claim.

tracks.objective: Test enzyme class and detergent combinations for predeclared soil/fibre pairs with matched controls and full rinse, residue, textile integrity and resource accounting.
tracks.maximum_inference: Only the tested stain recipe/age, fibre/dye, enzyme lot, dose, pH, temperature and process window; no universal detergent or cold-wash claim.

external_comparators.substrate_scope: Tested grey and dyed wool fabrics in the published study.
reported_outcomes: paper reports preservation of tested mechanical and colour attributes
external_comparators.reported_conditions: PCDI pre-fill followed by compound protease treatment; exact process parameters must be taken from full paper before replication.
external_comparators.scope_note: Published swatch-level study; polymer-assisted rather than enzyme-only; does not qualify repeated whole-garment washing.

external_comparators.substrate_scope: Dyed wool textiles in the published study.
reported_outcomes: reported improvement in air/moisture permeability and hand feel
external_comparators.reported_conditions: Compound protease wave-riding surface-modification process; exact activity/dose and wash protocol require full paper verification.
external_comparators.scope_note: Distinct all-enzyme wave-riding study in Green Chemistry; reports 3.90% ±0.12% felting/dimensional change, 11.39% ±0.61% strength loss and ΔE_CMC <1.00 for tested dyed wool fabrics.

auxiliary_chemistry: sodium thioglycolate STG or glycerol monomercaptoacetate GMT
external_comparators.substrate_scope: Grey and dyed wool fabrics in the published study.
reported_outcomes: authors report minimal strength loss and no colour change
external_comparators.reported_conditions: Reductive pre-treatment followed by protease scale hydrolysis.
external_comparators.scope_note: Auxiliary-reductant pathway, not enzyme-only; residual chemical, worker exposure, effluent and end-of-life require separate study.

external_comparators.substrate_scope: Dyed wool fabric in a two-bath process.
reported_outcomes: 5 g/L sodium bisulfite and 8 U/mL Savinase Ultra 16XL
external_comparators.reported_conditions: Sodium bisulfite pre-reduction followed by protease treatment.
external_comparators.scope_note: Distinct reductant-assisted method; do not pool with PCDI or protease-only results.

external_comparators.reported_conditions: Protease + lipase + detergent; study-specific stain/substrate and measurement reference.
external_comparators.scope_note: Not evidence of cold washing, wool suitability, broad stain removal or lower whole-cycle environmental impact; ΔE must be interpreted with reference and direction.

metrics.scope: Irreversible felting shrinkage measured separately from relaxation dimensional change.
Tensile strength retention with warp/weft direction and specimen geometry recorded.
Colour difference and staining on dyed wool after treatment and repeated laundering.
metrics.target_hypothesis: <=0.8 ΔE_CMC; stretch <=0.5, subject to validated repeatability and method uncertainty.

metrics.scope: Air/moisture permeability, hand, drape, elasticity, pilling and abrasion after repeated cycles.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Non-inferior to declared control within preregistered margins.

metrics.scope: Retain shrink-resist, strength, colour and comfort properties through 25 and 50 declared wash/dry cycles.
metrics.target_hypothesis: No breach of preregistered non-inferiority limits through 50 cycles.

metrics.scope: Enzyme protein and auxiliary chemical residues with skin-contact and migration relevance.
Stain removal with frozen stain recipe/age, substrate, reflectance method and blinded visual score.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Non-inferior to matched detergent control; superior only if confidence interval supports it.

metrics.scope: Unwanted dye loss, hue change and dye transfer after enzyme treatment/rinse.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Non-inferior to matched detergent control within preregistered margins.

metrics.scope: Tensile, dimensional change, pilling, fuzzing and surface damage for each substrate and enzyme class.
metrics.target_hypothesis: No material degradation beyond preregistered non-inferiority margins.

metrics.scope: Energy, water, detergent, enzyme, auxiliaries, rinse and effluent treatment over the full treatment/care boundary.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Reduce burden relative to matched baseline without quality or safety penalty.

metrics.scope: Whole-process wastewater load, biodegradability and chemical fate, including auxiliaries and comparator routes.
metrics.target_hypothesis: No unassessed adverse burden; quantify all relevant parameters.

metrics.scope: Inhalation/dermal exposure during enzyme and auxiliary handling, transfer, cleaning and maintenance.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Closed process with exposure assessment and no uncontrolled aerosol/powder task.

metrics.scope: Enzyme activity under detergent surfactant, oxidant, pH, temperature and storage conditions.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Establish stability envelope before any formulation claim.

metrics.scope: Accepted stain removal after localized pretreatment with rinse and whole-garment impact accounted.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Reduce unnecessary whole-garment processing for qualified target subset.

sources.scope_note: Polymer pre-fill plus compound protease; 5.06% felting shrinkage and +0.27% tensile change in tested wool fabric.
All-enzyme wave-riding dyed-wool anti-felting study; keep distinct from reductant-assisted sodium-bisulfite comparator.
Thioglycolate/GMT reductant plus protease; less than 4% felting shrinkage in tested fabrics.
Bisulfite pre-reduction plus protease; 4.14% shrinkage, 6.58% strength loss and ΔE below 1.1 in abstract.
Protease/lipase/detergent blood stain study on polyester/cotton at reported 60°C optimum.
2026 review discusses enzyme formulation stability, surfactant compatibility and oxidative stability.
Industrial reference describes auxiliary pretreatments, AOX trade-offs, operational durability and continuous-process challenges.
HSE lists alpha-amylases and subtilisins as occupational asthma causes, including detergent/textile uses.
Published domestic washing/drying test procedures for textile testing.
Published dimensional-change method confirmed current in 2022.
Published colour-fastness-to-laundering method; not a stain-removal metric.
